rows.replacement:
Compare this only with your own other nights. No reference range applies to wrist measurements.

Deceleration capacity averages the beats around each moment your heart rate slowed. A rising line can mean a cleaner signal, so check it against the anchor count and clean-beat share above. If you changed straps within this window, the two halves do not compare.

rows.comment: Safety disclaimer that must stay. Tighten, drop the em dash and the punchy "never could" fragment, keep every substantive warning.
lineComments: Replace the antithesis fragment with a direct statement.
Merge the two sentences; keep that no flag is not clearance and why days were not screened.
Keep the ECG and clinician advice, phrased directly.
rows.replacement:
This is a screen. It cannot diagnose a condition.

A day without a flag does not mean you were cleared, and the screen cannot rule anything out. Outlined days were not screened because they had too few clean beats or too much movement.

Wrist pulse is not an ECG. If you have symptoms, see a clinician for a proper test.
